name: Maker Faire Porto
description: A fantastic festival of invention, creativity, and resourcefulness. Explore everything from high-tech robotics to handmade crafts and art installations.
longDescription:
Maker Faire Porto returns to Alfândega do Porto on September 18, 2026, presenting a celebration of innovation and practical skills. This event, part of the global Maker Faire network, brings together hobbyists, engineers, artists, and educators to share their projects and processes. It serves as a platform for demonstrating ingenuity across a wide spectrum, from advanced technological prototypes to traditional artisanal methods.

Attendees can expect an environment filled with demonstrations, interactive exhibits, and opportunities to observe various creative processes. The atmosphere is generally one of curiosity and shared learning, appealing to individuals interested in how things are made and how ideas are brought to life. The event takes place within the historic Alfândega do Porto, a grand riverside building that provides ample space for diverse displays and activities.

Tickets are required for entry. The Alfândega do Porto is situated on the Douro riverfront, accessible by bus routes serving the Ribeira area, and within walking distance from the historic city centre. Further details on specific ticket tiers and purchase points will be made available closer to the event date.
